versions.name: Wah-Tut-Ca Scout Reservation
versions.summary: A Spirit of Adventure Council scout reservation on a large lake in Northwood, southeastern New Hampshire, historically run as a summer resident camp, with an extensive waterfront of nearly a mile of shoreline set among mature forest.

sources.citation: Added 2026-08-14 (method: curated) from a coverage gap surfaced by the scout-camp-map project; council corrected from the hint's Daniel Webster to Spirit of Adventure Council (the reservation's owner, formed from the Yankee Clipper and Boston Minuteman councils). Status set not_operating: the property exists and is council-owned but is no longer run as a council BSA summer camp following its transition and is under a multi-year lease to Lantern Light Camps Inc. Address corrected from the hint's 72 Jenness Pond Road to the verified 292 Blakes Hill Road. Coordinates geocoded via US Census (exact); elevation from open-meteo. Features unsurveyed; July normals pending a WorldClim resample.

provenance.notes: Coverage add: existence, corrected owning council, and dormant (leased-out, no council program) status verified; camp_type classified as its historical resident-camp nature; program_types left empty as it runs no current council program; features unsurveyed.
